description: Self-hosted, fully offline AI-powered development platform. Arbiter manages all project roadmaps and provides AI assistance for working on those projects — it does not integrate project code into its own engine.
pillars: Pillar 1 — Chat Engine: context-aware, multi-turn conversational development assistant
Pillar 2 — Visual Studio Integration: native VSIX extension for Visual Studio 2022
Pillar 3 — Self-Iteration: autonomous roadmap-driven self-build loop
Phase 1–7 — Full Vision: platform consolidation → tooling layer → server management → game systems (PCG/mech) → development agent → integration & testing → deployment & scaling

milestones.title: Reliability, Performance & Real-time Enhancement
milestones.description: Harden the server against crashes caused by blocking LLM calls in async contexts, add request-timeout middleware, an LRU response cache, a /metrics endpoint, WebSocket streaming chat, per-project AI budget tracking, enhanced health reporting, and automatic LLM backend failover.

tasks.title: Fix async event-loop blocking: wrap all synchronous LLM calls inside async route handlers and generators with asyncio.to_thread() so the uvicorn event loop is never blocked and the server remains responsive under concurrent load
Add global request timeout middleware: any route that has not responded within 30 seconds returns a 504 JSON error so clients never hang indefinitely waiting for an unresponsive LLM backend

Enhance /health endpoint: probe each configured LLM backend (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) and report reachability, latency, and loaded-model name alongside existing system metrics so operators can diagnose connectivity problems at a glance

Add in-memory LRU response cache (128 entries, TTL 5 min): identical prompt+project combinations served from cache, cutting latency to zero and reducing LLM backend load; cache stats exposed on /metrics

Add WebSocket /ws/chat endpoint: full-duplex real-time streaming chat channel where tokens are pushed to the client as they arrive from the LLM, replacing the SSE /chat/stream fallback with a lower-overhead persistent connection

Add per-project AI budget tracking: count estimated tokens and LLM call count per project; expose GET /budget/{project} and POST /budget/{project}/reset so developers can monitor and cap their local inference spend
Add /metrics endpoint: per-endpoint request counts, error counts, and P50/P95 response-time histograms; resets on server restart; feeds the Chat Analytics dashboard (M10-9)

Add automatic LLM backend failover: if the primary backend returns a connection error or timeout, transparently retry the request against the next backend in a configured fallback chain (e.g. ollama → lmstudio → api) and log which backend served the request

tasks.title: Code complexity metrics: compute per-function cyclomatic complexity and file-level maintainability index for Python via /analysis/complexity
tasks.notes: Implemented /analysis/complexity using ast-based cyclomatic complexity walker. Returns per-function scores with risk levels (low/medium/high/very-high), average CC, and code line counts.

tasks.title: Duplicate code detection: identify duplicate and near-duplicate code blocks across project files using rolling-window fingerprinting via /analysis/duplicates
tasks.notes: Implemented /analysis/duplicates using normalised min-lines window fingerprinting across .py/.js/.ts/.cs files. Returns grouped duplicate spans with file paths, line ranges, and code snippets.

tasks.title: API documentation generator: auto-generate Markdown, RST, or JSON documentation from Python source via AST extraction, with LLM fallback for other languages via /docs/generate
tasks.notes: Implemented /docs/generate with AST-based extraction for Python (classes, functions, docstrings, signatures) producing Markdown/RST/JSON output. Non-Python files fall back to LLM-generated docs.

tasks.title: Code coverage report parser: parse Cobertura XML (pytest-cov) and LCOV format coverage reports; optionally run tests with coverage collection via /analysis/coverage
tasks.notes: Implemented /analysis/coverage supporting coverage.xml (Cobertura) and lcov.info with optional pytest --cov run. Returns per-file coverage percentage, line counts, and overall project coverage.

tasks.title: Performance profiler integration: execute Python scripts under cProfile and return ranked hotspot list with call counts and timing via /analysis/profile
tasks.notes: Implemented /analysis/profile using cProfile to instrument Python script execution and pstats to parse results. Returns top-N hotspots with calls, total_time_s, cumulative_time_s per function.

tasks.title: AI-powered full code review workflow: combine static lint + complexity analysis with a structured LLM review pass evaluating correctness, security, performance, readability, and error-handling via /review/workflow
tasks.notes: Implemented /review/workflow combining M14-1 lint and M14-3 complexity results with an LLM prompt requesting structured JSON findings per checklist category. Returns merged static + AI findings with severity, line numbers, and fix suggestions.

milestones.title: Platform Consolidation
milestones.description: Consolidate all subsystems under one cohesive structure with uniform conventions, per-system logging, comprehensive documentation, and improved UX (server shutdown prompt, enhanced banner).

tasks.title: Per-system rotating log files in top-level logs/<system>/ subfolders
tasks.notes: Added setup_system_logging() to core/logger.py. ArbiterEngine writes to logs/arbiter_engine/, PythonBridge to logs/python_bridge/. Top-level logs/ directory created with subfolders for arbiter_engine, python_bridge, host_app, vs_extension, self_build.

tasks.title: Comprehensive documentation wiki in docs/wiki/
tasks.notes: Created docs/wiki/ with: README.md (index), ARCHITECTURE.md, GETTING_STARTED.md, CONFIGURATION.md, API_REFERENCE.md, LOGGING.md, SELF_BUILD.md, VS_EXTENSION.md, CHAT_ENGINE.md, MONACO_IDE.md, ROADMAP.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, TROUBLESHOOTING.md.

tasks.title: Server shutdown prompt — ask user to keep servers live or shut down on app close
tasks.notes: Updated App.xaml.cs App_Exit handler to show a Yes/No dialog when managed server processes are running. Yes = kill processes; No = leave running for remote web UI access.

tasks.title: Enhanced README banner with tool icons, roadmap section, and updated milestone badges
tasks.notes: README updated: version badge 1.1.0, milestones badge M0-M14 complete, roadmap ASCII visualization below banner, tool suite icon grid, Documentation section with wiki links.

tasks.title: ROADMAP.md as standalone user-facing roadmap document
tasks.notes: Created ROADMAP.md at repo root covering all completed milestones (M0-M14) and all 7 implementation phases (Phase 1 Consolidation through Phase 7 Deployment & Scaling).

tasks.title: Master Design Bible in docs/design/MASTER_DESIGN_BIBLE.md covering full system architecture, feature specifications, and all integration points
tasks.notes: MASTER_DESIGN_BIBLE.md created at docs/design/MASTER_DESIGN_BIBLE.md

tasks.title: In-application Wiki panel populated from docs/wiki/ markdown files via /wiki REST endpoint
tasks.notes: Added GET /wiki (list all docs/wiki/ pages) and GET /wiki/{page} (return raw markdown) endpoints to server.py. Pages are served from docs/wiki/. Path traversal prevented.

tasks.title: Changelog automation — generate CHANGELOG entries from git log [arbiter-self-build] commits
tasks.notes: Added POST /changelog/generate (parses git log for [arbiter-self-build] commits, groups by date, writes docs/wiki/CHANGELOG.md) and GET /changelog endpoints to server.py.

milestones.title: Tooling Layer & AI Integration
milestones.description: Single interface for AI-assisted development and project management across all project types. WPF-based UI for all editor tools integrated with Visual Studio and ArbiterAI.

tasks.title: Arbiter IDE complete rework — WPF shell retained; full redesign of panels, layout, and interaction model; no ImGui dependencies
tasks.notes: ArbiterEngine IDE integration reworked: /projects/list enumerates tracked projects (name, version, active phase, task progress). WPF IdeWindow continues to use Monaco via WebView2. New /vs/capabilities, /vs/inline-completion, /vs/explain-diagnostic, /vs/refactor endpoints provide the deeper integration layer.

tasks.title: Deeper Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio plugin integration
tasks.notes: Added /vs/capabilities, /vs/inline-completion, /vs/explain-diagnostic, and /vs/refactor to ArbiterEngine server.py. These endpoints are consumed by the Arbiter VSIX and VS Code extension for inline completions, diagnostic explanations, and AI-driven refactoring.

tasks.title: ArbiterAI agent for automated coding, asset iteration, PCG, and system debugging
tasks.notes: Added POST /agent/run to server.py: multi-step Plan→Act→Observe loop with configurable max_steps, persona (specialist), project context injection, write_file and run_analysis actions, and dry_run mode. Returns full step trace and final_answer.

tasks.title: Open-source model integration (Ollama, CodeGeeX, etc.) for unrestricted free code assistance
tasks.notes: Added CodeGeeX LLM backend (llm/codegeex.py): OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions, stream_chat, tool_call, list_models. Registered in factory.py and config.toml. Added GET /models/backends (all backends + reachability) and POST /models/switch (hot-swap active LLM without restart).

milestones.notes: Post-Phase2 additions: /roles/* API access control, /audit/* audit log, GET /dashboard Arbiter admin panel.

milestones.title: Project-Aware Workspace Intelligence
milestones.description: Arbiter becomes aware of the projects it manages. New endpoints let Arbiter prime its AI context from any project's files and roadmap, introspect the live git workspace, scaffold new projects via AI, and persist workspace state across sessions.

tasks.title: POST /projects/{id}/activate — prime AI context with project roadmap, key files, and recent commits
tasks.notes: POST /projects/{id}/activate: loads project roadmap (completion stats, pending tasks), source file list, recent git commits into workspace_state active_project_context. Response includes summary and context length.

tasks.title: GET /projects/{id}/health — roadmap completion %, pending task count, last git activity
tasks.notes: GET /projects/{id}/health: returns roadmap version, total/done/pending task counts, completion_pct, active_phase, and last 10 git commits for the project path.

tasks.title: GET /git/status, GET /git/log, GET /git/diff — live git introspection for the active workspace
tasks.notes: Existing /git/status, /git/log, /git/diff endpoints (from earlier milestones) already fulfil workspace introspection. Enhanced /git/diff with ?staged=true to return staged (cached) diffs alongside normal working-tree diffs.

tasks.title: GET /workspace/state + POST /workspace/state — persist active project, preferences to .arbiter/workspace_state.json
tasks.notes: GET /workspace/state: returns persisted state (active_project, recent_files, preferences) from .arbiter/workspace_state.json (excludes large context blob). POST /workspace/state: merges supplied fields; recent_files deduplicated, capped at 20.

tasks.title: POST /projects/scaffold — AI-assisted new project scaffolding from a text description
tasks.notes: POST /projects/scaffold: validates project_id, creates Projects/{id}/ skeleton (src/ docs/ tests/ config/ scripts/), roadmap.json, workspace_profile.json. AI enriches roadmap phases from description if LLM is available.

milestones.title: Development Agent Enhancement
milestones.description: Extend the Arbiter AI agent with repo monitoring, automated commit review, a self-build loop, and test orchestration so Arbiter can participate actively in any project's development cycle.

tasks.title: GET /git/watch (SSE) — stream new commit events as they land; surface AI-generated summaries
tasks.notes: GET /git/watch (SSE): polls git log every N seconds (clamp 5–300s). Emits one event per new commit with sha, author, date, subject, ai_summary. Heartbeat event sent when no new commits. Scoped to Projects/{project} path if supplied.

tasks.title: POST /git/review-commit — AI reviews the latest commit diff and returns structured feedback
tasks.notes: POST /git/review-commit: fetches diff for any SHA/branch (defaults HEAD). LLM returns JSON: summary, issues[], suggestions[], verdict (approve|needs_work|blocking). SHA whitelist validated; diff capped at max_diff_chars (default 6000).

tasks.title: POST /self/improve — Arbiter agent proposes and applies improvements to its own codebase via the agent loop
tasks.notes: POST /self/improve: runs the Plan→Act→Observe agent loop scoped to AIEngine/ArbiterEngine/. dry_run=True by default — only proposes changes, never writes without explicit opt-in. Optional target_file scopes analysis to a single source file.

tasks.title: POST /tests/run — run a project's test suite and feed results back to the AI for analysis
tasks.notes: POST /tests/run: auto-detects pytest/dotnet/npm/cargo/go test runner. Runs test suite with configurable timeout (10–600s). AI analyses combined stdout+stderr and returns pass/fail root cause and next-step suggestions.

milestones.title: Production & Deployment
milestones.description: Package and harden Arbiter for production use: Docker support, auto-update, multi-user API key scoping, rate limiting, and a plugin system for extending the API with custom modules.

tasks.title: Dockerfile for ArbiterEngine — single-container deployment with config volume mount
tasks.notes: Dockerfile updated: added /app/arbiter-config, /app/configs, /app/plugins volumes. docker-compose.yml has corresponding named volumes. docker-entrypoint.sh symlinks volumes into container on start.

tasks.title: POST /self/update — pull latest Arbiter source, apply, and hot-reload endpoints without downtime
tasks.notes: POST /self/update: git fetch + git pull --ff-only; returns sha_before/sha_after, pull_summary, changed_files. restart=true triggers os.execv after 2s delay. Branch name validated with _GIT_REF_PATTERN.

tasks.title: Multi-user API keys — per-user keys with role enforcement; rate limiting middleware
tasks.notes: Multi-user API keys stored in .arbiter/api_keys.json. X-API-Key header validated by _ApiKeyRateLimitMiddleware. Rate limiter: sliding 60s window per key (or per IP when no keys registered). CRUD: POST /api-keys/create, GET /api-keys, DELETE /api-keys/{key_id}, POST /api-keys/{key_id}/disable|enable, POST /api-keys/validate.

tasks.title: Plugin system — loadable Python modules in plugins/ that register new FastAPI routes on startup
tasks.notes: Plugin route registration: plugins/*/routes.py can expose 'router' (APIRouter) or 'register(app)' callable. PluginLoader stores _dir in meta for discovery. POST /plugins/install now fully functional. GET /plugins/routes lists mounted paths.

milestones.title: Cross-Project Intelligence
milestones.description: Extend Arbiter's awareness across all managed project workspaces. New API capabilities: AI-assisted commit messages, structured AI planning, unified git timeline, dependency graph parsing, workspace snapshots, compressed project context summaries, and cross-project file search.

tasks.title: POST /ai/commit-message — diff + context → AI-generated conventional commit message
POST /ai/plan — natural-language goal → structured task list for project roadmap
GET /workspace/timeline — unified git commit timeline across all managed Projects/
GET /projects/{id}/dependencies — parse requirements.txt / package.json / .csproj / go.mod / Cargo.toml into a structured dependency list
POST /workspace/snapshot, GET /workspace/snapshots, POST /workspace/snapshots/{id}/restore — named workspace state snapshots
POST /projects/{id}/context/summary — AI-generated compressed architecture summary for fast context injection
GET /projects/search — full-text search across all files in all managed project workspaces

milestones.title: Observability & Developer Experience
milestones.description: Enhance Arbiter's operational visibility and day-to-day developer ergonomics. New API capabilities: runtime metrics, per-project activity feeds, on-demand AI code explanation, aggregate workspace health check, git blame with AI commentary, and AI-generated changelogs from git history.

tasks.title: GET /metrics — runtime stats: request counts, LLM latency p50/p95/p99, memory usage, uptime
GET /projects/{id}/activity — per-project activity feed combining git commits, test runs, AI calls, and open issues
POST /ai/explain — paste any code snippet or error message, get AI explanation with optional archive cross-reference
GET /workspace/health — aggregate health check: all projects + git status + LLM backend + disk space
POST /git/blame-explain — git blame a file path and have the AI summarise ownership and change history per logical block
POST /projects/{id}/changelog — generate a human-readable CHANGELOG from git log, grouped by version tag or date range

milestones.title: Smart Automation & Workspace Productivity
milestones.description: Raise Arbiter's automation ceiling with project-wide code intelligence and workflow tools. New capabilities: whole-project refactoring analysis, AI-generated documentation suites, workspace TODO aggregation, framework migration planning, roadmap effort estimation, and AI unit-test stub generation.

tasks.title: POST /ai/project-refactor — project-wide code-smell & refactoring opportunity analysis across all source files
tasks.notes: POST /ai/project-refactor: scans up to 30 source files in the project, builds compact excerpts, asks LLM to rank up to 8 refactoring opportunities by impact. Each opportunity includes file, impact (High/Medium/Low), category, and description. Optional focus hint steers analysis.

tasks.title: POST /projects/{id}/docs — AI-generated project documentation suite: overview, architecture, module summaries, API reference, and a Markdown README skeleton
tasks.notes: POST /projects/{id}/docs: reads roadmap.json + up to 20 source files, generates overview/architecture/modules/api_summary sections via LLM. Returns structured JSON plus a ready-to-use Markdown README skeleton.

tasks.title: GET /workspace/todos — aggregate all TODO/FIXME/HACK/NOTE/DEPRECATED annotations across every managed project
tasks.notes: GET /workspace/todos: regex-scans source files in all Projects/ directories (or a single project). Returns items grouped by project with file, line, category, and text. Supports project/category/limit query params.

tasks.title: POST /ai/migrate — AI-generated step-by-step framework/runtime migration plan with breaking changes, risk levels, and code examples
tasks.notes: POST /ai/migrate: accepts project_id, from_framework, to_framework, notes. Samples up to 10 source files for context. LLM returns overview, breaking_changes[], steps[] (each with step, risk, title, detail), and estimated_effort.

tasks.title: POST /projects/{id}/estimate — AI effort and complexity estimation (Low/Medium/High + hours range + risk) for every pending roadmap task
tasks.notes: POST /projects/{id}/estimate: parses roadmap.json for pending tasks, asks LLM to produce per-task estimates. Returns estimates[] with complexity, hours, risk, dependencies, plus complexity_summary totals.

tasks.title: POST /projects/{id}/test-generate — AI generates unit-test stubs (pytest/jest/xunit/auto) for all untested functions and classes in a project
tasks.notes: POST /projects/{id}/test-generate: detects test framework from existing test files, scans up to 15 source files, generates complete test stub files per source file with arrange/act/assert structure and TODO markers. Supports file_path restriction.

milestones.title: Advanced Collaboration & Knowledge Management
milestones.description: Deepen Arbiter's role as a knowledge hub for every workspace. New capabilities: narrative AI code walkthroughs, static test-coverage estimation, persistent developer notes, project velocity dashboards, programmatic roadmap task creation, and a cross-project executive workspace summary.

tasks.title: POST /ai/code-walkthrough — narrative AI walkthrough of any source file: purpose, execution flow, key decisions, and gotchas
tasks.notes: POST /ai/code-walkthrough: reads file_path (project-relative or absolute) or inline content, applies audience hint (developer/reviewer/onboarding). LLM returns structured PURPOSE/FLOW/KEY_DECISIONS/GOTCHAS sections.

tasks.title: GET /projects/{id}/coverage-report — static test-coverage estimation via symbol name cross-reference (no test execution required)
tasks.notes: GET /projects/{id}/coverage-report: uses ast.walk for Python, regex for other langs to list public symbols; cross-references symbol names against test file content. Returns per-file breakdown and overall_coverage % with uncovered symbol lists.

tasks.title: GET+POST+DELETE /workspace/notes — persistent multi-project developer scratchpad notes with full-text search
tasks.notes: Three endpoints: GET /workspace/notes (list, filter by project/q/limit), POST /workspace/notes (create note with title/body/project/tags), DELETE /workspace/notes/{id} (delete by id). Persisted to logs/workspace_notes.json with atomic writes.

tasks.title: GET /projects/{id}/progress — velocity and progress dashboard: roadmap completion stats, commit frequency, open TODO count
tasks.notes: GET /projects/{id}/progress: combines roadmap completion pct, active phase, git commit frequency (by week over last N weeks), recent commits list, and open TODO/FIXME count from static scan.

tasks.title: POST /projects/{id}/roadmap/task — add a new task to a project roadmap programmatically with AI-generated description
tasks.notes: POST /projects/{id}/roadmap/task: validates phase_id exists in roadmap.json, auto-generates task id, AI enriches description if blank, atomically rewrites roadmap.json. Supports status (pending/in_progress/done).

tasks.title: GET /workspace/summary — cross-project executive summary: status of all projects, recent activity, open TODOs, AI narrative
tasks.notes: GET /workspace/summary: iterates all Projects/ directories, collects roadmap completion, 7-day git commits, TODO count, last-modified. LLM writes 2-4 sentence executive narrative. Returns projects[] array plus narrative and generated_at timestamp.
